title: What's new in v2.9.2
summary: Roll out a UniFi OS, device, or UniFi Network build as soon as any of your Consoles is offered it, or paste its download link yourself.

steps.title: Add Firmware by URL
steps.listLabel: Roll out a build before your Consoles are offered it
steps.body:
Paste a Ubiquiti download link for device firmware, UniFi OS, or the UniFi Network application. Network Optimizer works out what it is for and offers it to every site on Early Access.

**Plan Rollout Now** takes you straight to the preview of a rollout that starts now.
